problem: The placeholder was translated to {பெயர்}. Placeholders stay byte-exact, so this must remain {name}. The checker reports a broken placeholder because the vowel sign is not part of the name.

billing.stop_renewal is written with ரத்துசெய், the dialog cancel (dialog.cancel_action). Stopping renewal keeps access until the period ends. It is not dismissing a dialog. dialogCancel correctly stays ரத்துசெய்.
The help sentence is still the English source. It is not a brand or a glossary term. {date} must stay as-is.

Machine-translated button. வெற்றிகரமாக (“successfully”) does not belong on the control, and சேமிக்கவும் is the long polite form. The rest of the file uses a short verb. Intent is form.save_draft: store the draft, unpublished.
நீக்கு is ordinary delete (item.delete). This control is item.delete_permanently, and the label does not say the deletion cannot be undone.
காப்பிடு is the Android Settings archive string and it means copy, not item.archive. The item stays recoverable; it is not copied.
إلغاء is the dialog cancel (OOUI dialog.cancel_action). It does not stop automatic renewal. Access continues until {date}; the subscription is not ended today. dialogCancel correctly stays إلغاء.
Arabic cardinals are zero, one, two, few, many, and other. This plural has only one and other, and the noun does not change shape for the missing counts (0, 2, 3–10, 11–99, 100+).
replacement: {count, plural, zero {لا إيصالات} one {# إيصال} two {# إيصالان} few {# إيصالات} many {# إيصالًا} other {# إيصال}}

problem: تحميل is the usual word for upload or loading. content.download is a file coming onto the device.
Latin “?” inside an Arabic sentence. The English empty state is a statement, “No receipts yet.”, not a question. The other Arabic sentence in this file already ends with a period.
حذف is generic delete. This control is item.delete_permanently and must say the deletion is final.
保存します is a polite sentence. A button is the noun 保存, without ます. saveDraft in the same file already uses 保存.
キャンセル is the dialog cancel. This button stops automatic renewal and leaves access until the date. dialogCancel correctly stays キャンセル.
Japanese cardinals are other only. The one branch is an English category this locale does not use. Both branches say the same thing.
取消 is the dialog cancel. This control stops renewal; it does not close a dialog and it does not end access today. dialogCancel correctly stays 取消. Simplified 停止续订, not the Traditional 停止續訂.
The sentence mixes 您 and 你. Billing copy uses one address, 您, for the whole file. The second clause repeats the same fact with the other pronoun.
过滤器 is a physical or technical filter, a dictionary calque. Clearing search filters uses 筛选. This does not delete receipts.
Workspace is still English. It is not the product name. Northwind stays untranslated; this label does not.
Abbrechen is the dialog cancel. This button stops the next renewal and keeps access until {date}. It does not end the subscription today. dialogCancel correctly stays Abbrechen.
The only direct address in the file is du, on a billing sentence. Nothing else uses du. Billing defaults to Sie when the product has no du voice. Buttons stay infinitives either way.
Herunterladen Sie is ungrammatical. The infinitive does not take Sie. The button is the bare infinitive.
Batal is the dialog cancel (Android dialog.cancel_action). This button stops automatic renewal. Access continues until {date}. dialogCancel correctly stays Batal.

Nafi is Android’s generic deny and sounds like a legal finding. This is a camera permission prompt (“Don’t allow”). Tolak is the attested decline on that kind of prompt. Both are source-attested; Tolak is the one that matches the control.
Malay cardinals are other only. The one branch is an unused English category. The noun does not take a plural form, so one string is the whole message.
Unduh is Indonesian. This file is Bahasa Malaysia. The Malay download verb is Muat turun. Sign-in in the same file correctly uses Log masuk, not Masuk.
Padam is ordinary delete. The control is item.delete_permanently. Indonesian “Hapus permanen” would also be the wrong language.
Arkib is the Android Settings noun. The control is a verb button (item.archive). A noun label does not tell the user they are archiving the item.
रद्द करें is the dialog cancel. This button stops automatic renewal and keeps access until {date}. dialogCancel correctly stays रद्द करें. The polite आप form stays रोकें, not a तुम imperative.
{amount} was dropped, so the button no longer says what will be charged. billing.pay_now submits payment at this step.

अभी नहीं is Android’s skip string and means “not now”. It postpones the step. This control is permissions.deny_access on a camera prompt (“Don’t allow”). The skip draft छोड़ें would also be the wrong action.
Hindi cardinals are one and other. Only other is present, and its noun रसीदें is plural, so a count of 1 is forced into the plural.
मिटाएँ is the attested ordinary delete (item.delete). This control is item.delete_permanently and does not say the deletion cannot be undone.
